verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a native access-review workflow. It reminds teams to start reviews on their policy's timelines, suggests in-scope critical systems, validates access changes before a review is finished, uses Head Start to focus consecutive reviews on changes, and automates gathering audit evidence. That covers the periodic, in-platform review cycle with evidence output. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that user lists are pulled from connected-app integrations, detail on the reviewer sign-off and approval mechanics, confirmation that the artifact always lands in the evidence library (the docs qualify this with 'when applicable'), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
